audience: workplace teams that manage desk and parking bookings in Skedway

useCases.title: Check the Skedway API status
useCases.text: Read the public API health status. The result does not prove any user's booking status.

useCases.title: Check a user in for eligible bookings
useCases.text: Check a user into all currently eligible desk and parking bookings. This changes attendance and can notify the user. Creates no new booking.

useCases.title: Confirm the API, then check a user in
useCases.text: Read the API health first, then check the user in. Check-in changes attendance and can notify the user.
